items.author: TheBTCTherapist
items.context: The Bitcoin Therapist: Bitcoin cotiza apenas $1.000 sobre el piso del power law y $122.000 bajo su 'valor justo'; 'estas oportunidades no duran mucho' (con gráfico).
items.suggested_text: Sitting near the power law floor is a useful reference, not a promise. The model has held for years, but a floor is a zone, not a line, and nothing stops price from wicking under it for a while. I mapped the projection out to 2050 here, same caveats included: https://x.com/forecastquant/status/2119169301949141264

items.author: RealAllinCrypto
items.context: ALLINCRYPTO: Bitcoin llegó a su media de 200 semanas cerca de $68.000; Matt Cole (Strive) lo llama una oportunidad histórica de compra porque ese indicador históricamente marcó fondos de $BTC. Pregunta si es una oportunidad generacional.
items.suggested_text: Touching the 200W is one thing; holding weekly closes above it is what made those past bottoms. Spot and no leverage is the only way I'd want to find out which one this is for $BTC.

items.author: Cointelegraph
items.context: Cointelegraph comparte entrevista a Mike McGlone (Bloomberg): con la Fed subiendo tasas, mal signo para todos los activos de riesgo; cree que el mercado bajista de acciones recién empezó y qué podría significar para Bitcoin.
items.suggested_text: If equities really are starting a bear market, the short-term correlation will probably drag $BTC with them. The question for me is whether it decouples later, like it did after past liquidity shocks, or keeps trading as a high-beta tech proxy.

items.author: USronaldcarter
items.context: Ronald Carter publica su calendario para 2027: enero trampa bajista, febrero ruptura de Bitcoin, abril nuevo ATH cerca de $215K, junio cascada de liquidaciones, julio mercado bajista; dice haber anticipado techos y fondos por 10 años.
items.suggested_text: A month-by-month roadmap is fun to read, but the value is in what would invalidate it. If February comes and $BTC hasn't broken out, what's the signal that the plan is off?
